001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003/**
004 * Represents a barge ({@code Barca}) occupying a single board position.
005 * Its bearing is stored but does not affect its shape.
006 */
007public class Barge extends Ship {
008    /** Number of positions occupied by a barge. */
009    private static final Integer SIZE = 1;
010    /** Category name used to identify barges. */
011    private static final String NAME = "Barca";
012
013    /**
014     * Creates a barge at a copy of the supplied coordinates.
015     *
016     * @param bearing the non-null bearing to associate with the barge
017     * @param pos the non-null position occupied by the barge
018     */
019    public Barge(Compass bearing, IPosition pos) {
020        super(Barge.NAME, bearing, pos);
021        getPositions().add(new Position(pos.getRow(), pos.getColumn()));
022    }
023
024    /**
025     * Returns the fixed size of a barge.
026     *
027     * @return one occupied position
028     */
029    @Override
030    public Integer getSize() {
031        return SIZE;
032    }
033
034}
